answer: Proof of Useful Work serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, where agents must solve computationally intensive problems akin to refining quartz to validate network state. Each identity requires a unique proof that cannot echo existing solutions, forcing attackers to incur exponential energy costs across a vast meadow of compute resources. By binding identity to verifiable expenditure rather than network entry, the system ensures that spinning up fake agents becomes economically prohibitive.
